eligibility_simplification_principle: Replace complex legalistic paragraphs with dynamic YES/NO question trees in Sympho Center's wizard, preventing users from filling out applications they do not qualify for.

sympho_wizard_questions.text: Are you a permanent resident of Tamil Nadu?
sympho_wizard_questions.failure_message: Only permanent residents of Tamil Nadu are eligible for this certificate.

sympho_wizard_questions.text: Are you a citizen of India?
sympho_wizard_questions.failure_message: Applicant must be a citizen of India.

sympho_wizard_questions.text: Are you a permanent resident of Tamil Nadu?
sympho_wizard_questions.failure_message: Only permanent residents of Tamil Nadu are eligible for this certificate.

sympho_wizard_questions.text: Do you belong to a recognized community category (SC, ST, BC, MBC, or DNC) in Tamil Nadu?
sympho_wizard_questions.tamil_text: நீங்கள் தமிழ்நாட்டில் அங்கீகரிக்கப்பட்ட சமூகப் பிரிவைச் (SC, ST, BC, MBC, அல்லது DNC) சேர்ந்தவரா?
sympho_wizard_questions.failure_message: You must belong to a recognized caste category in Tamil Nadu to apply for a community certificate.

sympho_wizard_questions.text: Are you a native of Tamil Nadu?
sympho_wizard_questions.failure_message: Only natives of Tamil Nadu can apply for a first graduate concession.

sympho_wizard_questions.text: Are any of your family members (parents, siblings, or grandparents) graduates?
sympho_wizard_questions.tamil_text: உங்கள் குடும்ப உறுப்பினர்கள் (பெற்றோர், உடன்பிறப்புகள், அல்லது தாத்தா பாட்டி) யாராவது பட்டதாரியா?
sympho_wizard_questions.failure_message: If any family member has completed a graduation degree, you are not eligible for this certificate.

sympho_wizard_questions.text: Are you a permanent resident of Tamil Nadu?
sympho_wizard_questions.failure_message: Only permanent residents of Tamil Nadu can apply for a ration card.

sympho_wizard_questions.text: Do you or any member of your family hold an active ration card in Tamil Nadu or any other state?
sympho_wizard_questions.tamil_text: உங்களுக்கோ அல்லது உங்கள் குடும்ப உறுப்பினருக்கோ தமிழ்நாட்டிலோ அல்லது வேறு எந்த மாநிலத்திலோ செயலில் உள்ள ரேஷன் கார்டு உள்ளதா?
sympho_wizard_questions.failure_message: A family can only hold one active ration card. If a member already holds a card, they must apply for 'Name Deletion' first.
